cited.quote: This Government is committed to complete the Athikadavu-Avinashi scheme.

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) only states commitment to complete the scheme; no new GO, sanction or measure for it. C2-C5 are urban scheme guidelines unrelated to the project. Statement of intent only, so not started.
C1-C5 concern disciplinary cases of officials, audit findings, AEFI guidelines and promotion procedures; none is about withdrawing cases against journalists.

cited.quote: listed in the Annexure-I to these Guidelines upto a maximum of Rupees Five Lakh
to extend the scope of assistance for medical treatments available under the existing Scheme

rationale: C1/C2 (GO 160, 2021-06-29) issue the New Health Insurance Scheme 2021 covering employees and family members, Rs.5 lakh (Rs.10 lakh for specified surgeries), cashless in private network hospitals, extending scope of the existing scheme. Whether the limit is higher than before is only implied (C4 shows lower limits elsewhere).

cited.quote: a detailed assessment of all the jewel loans disbursed is required before the waiver is taken up

rationale: C2 says the jewel loan waiver is on the agenda but a detailed assessment is required first; the crop loan waiver provision relates to the previous government's scheme and is a budget provision. No GO waiving the loans in C1-C5.

cited.quote: 647 works at a total cost of Rs.65.11 crore covering 9 districts have been taken up and completed
Desilting a length of 4,061 kilometers of channels has been taken up

rationale: C2 and C3 report Cauvery delta channel desilting taken up after assumption of office and completed (C1 says before the 12th June dam opening). No extract shows new canal construction being operationalised, so only the desilting part is done. Date is approximate (June 2021 per C3).

cited.quote: insurance is provided to cover yield losses on an area based approach basis

rationale: C1-C5 show continuation of the crop insurance scheme (area-based approach, C5) and wildlife damage compensation (C4); none is a dedicated new measure ensuring compensation when a single farmer's land is affected.

cited.quote: Solar High Mast Lights in vantage points like traffic junctions, market places etc., CCTV Camera at vantage points.

rationale: C1 only lists CCTV cameras at vantage points as an optional work under Namakku Naame Thittam; no legal requirement or step to install CCTV in schools, hospitals, bus stands, police stations and temples. C2-C5 unrelated.
C1 is on loan waivers, C2/C3 on TIIC industrial finance, C4 on crop insurance, C5 on local body grants; none is about an interest-free loan scheme for small vendors.

cited.quote: 12 new Primary Schools will be opened and 22 Schools will be upgraded

rationale: C1 (policy note) covers opening new schools generally and in hilly and remote areas, not fishermen areas; C2-C5 do not show any step for schools in fishermen areas.

C1-C5 concern UGC qualification rules, an audit of higher education, 7.5% preferential seats and a commission on government school students; none is about guidelines for IT firm and higher education tie-ups.

cited.quote: To create an ecosystem of academic institutions, research organizations, start-ups, funding agencies and eminent individuals.

rationale: C1 states a general TNeGA objective of an ecosystem with academic institutions; no MoU or partnership programme between IT firms and universities is shown. C2-C5 unrelated.

cited.quote: appointed a Special Officer to resolve all the grievance petitions received during the programme
all the 4,57,645 petitions received under the programme have been acted upon

rationale: C1 reports a Special Officer appointed to resolve all petitions from the programme within 100 days; C2 reports all 4,57,645 petitions acted upon and the 100-day commitment implemented. Exact appointment date not given; year only.

cited.quote: subsidy assistance of Rs.10,000/- will be extended for purchasing new electric motor pumpsets

rationale: C1 is a budget announcement (will be extended) of a Rs.10,000 subsidy for farmers with under three acres; no GO or launch in C1-C5 (C5 is SMAM revalidation, C4 crop insurance).

cited.quote: Tamil literary works have been brought out in English as joint publications by collaborating with leading publishers

rationale: C1/C2 (policy note) describe ongoing Textbook Corporation translation activity and plans for a second phase, with no dated new GO or launch after taking office. C3-C5 unrelated.
C1 and C5 list flood restoration culverts and drains in Tiruvannamalai district; C2-C4 are on urban employment and other roads. None is about a concrete girivalam path.
C1-C3 are urban infrastructure scheme guidelines, C4 MSME subsidy, C5 TIIC finance; none mentions washermen equipment or washing centres.
C1/C2 are Governor's address passages, C3 mentions digitising Assembly archives, C4/C5 land records; none is about live telecast of Assembly proceedings.

rationale: C3 (budget speech) only gives an allocation for marriage assistance schemes; C1 lists the scheme as an e-service. No step raising assistance to Rs.30,000 or providing 8 grams of gold.

cited.quote: the reduction in retail price of Aavin milk by Rs.3 per litre

rationale: C1 states one of the government's first five orders reduced the retail price of Aavin milk by Rs.3 per litre. The order's exact date is not given; only the year is supported.
